**Target reading of the submit slice (GAP-2711).** The filing is written on `guarantee_claim` as status `FILED` with `filed_at` as the business date, and no submission-reference element is published until the Logical Data Model names a field identifier. The TCG claim channel is a recorded officer filing with no outbound call, file or queue until INT-29 publishes an interface. The claim status map fixes only PREPARING to FILED; the case statuses CLAIM_APPROVAL, CLAIM_PART_PAID and CLAIM_SUBMITTED stay with rwb-case. The two working-day timers and the service events are not declared in this contract.
